request.query: The length or coefficient absolute sum of the zero polynomial is zero.

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), Polynomial.coeff 0 n = 0

items.name: Polynomial.content_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R], Polynomial.content 0 = 0

items.name: Polynomial.sum_zero_index
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S), Polynomial.sum 0 f = 0

items.name: Polynomial.length_coeffList_eq_ite
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] (P : Polynomial R),
  P.coeffList.length = if P = 0 then 0 else P.natDegree + 1

items.name: Polynomial.signVariations_zero
items.type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R], Polynomial.signVariations 0 = 0

items.name: Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.leadingCoeff = 0 ↔ p = 0
